name: Amobarbital
summary: A sedative and hypnotic barbiturate first discovered in 1923. Formerly widely used recreationally and medically, barbiturates have declined in popularity with the appearance of benzodiazepines and other drugs with less serious consequences in overdose.

pharmacology.text: In an in vitro study in rat thalamic slices, amobarbital worked by activating GABAA receptors, which decreased input resistance, depressed burst and tonic firing, especially in ventrobasal and intralaminar neurons, while at the same time increasing burst duration and mean conductance at individual chloride channels; this increased both the amplitude and decay time of inhibitory postsynaptic currents.

uses.text: Amobarbital was widely misused, known as "Blue Heavens" on the street.

zhOther: 青發, 安米妥鈉, 異戊巴比妥鈉
summaryZh: 異戊巴比妥舊名 amylobarbitone，是一種巴比妥類藥物的衍生物，主要的功能是用於作為中效鎮靜劑，以治療如失眠之類的症狀。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, slurred speech, poor coordination and confusion. Overdose can stop breathing and be fatal. Regular use brings tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause seizures and delirium that can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、口齒不清、協調變差與混亂。過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，突然停藥可能引起危及生命的癲癇發作與譫妄。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、口齿不清、协调制差与混乱。过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，突然停药可能引起危及生命的癫痫发作与谵妄。

fact.en: Amobarbital was first made in 1923 and sold in blue capsules, which earned it the street name Blue Heavens. It is still used in the Wada test, where one side of the brain is briefly put to sleep before surgery.
fact.zh: 異戊巴比妥於 1923 年首次合成，以藍色膠囊販售，因此得到「Blue Heavens」的街頭別名。它至今仍用於 Wada 測試，也就是在手術前短暫讓單側大腦入睡的檢查。
fact.zhHans: 异戊巴比妥于 1923 年首次合成，以蓝色胶囊贩售，因此得到「Blue Heavens」的街头别名。它至今仍用于 Wada 测试，也就是在手术前短暂让单侧大脑入睡的检查。
